sanskrit_verse:
कूटसब ह्यः कूटसाक्षी ब्रह्महा च समाः स्मृताः ।
भ्रूणहा मित्रहा चैषां नाधिकः समुदाहृतः ॥
transliteration: kūṭasab hyaḥ kūṭasākṣī brahmahā ca samāḥ smṛtāḥ | bhrūṇahā mitrahā caiṣāṃ nādhikaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The false witness, the betrayer of sacred trust, the killer of a Brahmin, and the destroyer of the unborn are equal in consequence; none greater than these has been declared.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not institutional position
Causation arises through disruption of consciousness continuity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of dharmic consequence
Restoration logic demands realignment of causal fields disrupted by adharmic acts
Consciousness alignment requires purification and reintegration of violated truths
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor violates foundational dharma THEN initiate consciousness-restoration protocol
IF witness distorts truth THEN disqualify from future testimony AND assign truth-rehabilitation process
IF act disrupts lineage continuity THEN invoke ancestral reconciliation procedure
IF Brahminicide occurs THEN enforce universal purification until collective consciousness stabilizes
IF fetal destruction occurs THEN mandate reproductive integrity restoration for perpetrator
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, threshold of responsibility lies in recognition of consciousness disruption. Hierarchical equivalence among listed offenses indicates uniform collapse of dharma-field integrity. Judgment must prioritize restoration of violated ontological structures over punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that all listed violations equally disrupt sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Each offense collapses specific causal layers—truth-bearing, spiritual sanctity, generational flow, and life-source purity. Responsibility aligns proportionally to capacity for consciousness realignment. No punitive outcome arises; only completion and reintegration proceed.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Satya-Sambandha Shuddhi (Truth Relationship Purification) for false witnesses
Execute Vak-Siddhi Pratishtha (Speech Integrity Re-establishment) for betrayers of trust
Undertake Brahma-Tejas Samyama (Brahmin Energy Integration) for Brahminicide perpetrators
Perform Garbha-Chaitanya Pratishtha (Fetal Consciousness Reconnection) for fetal destroyers
Assign Mitra-Shakti Punarsthapana (Friendship Force Reconstruction) for those who betray allies
final_declaration: Declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as Source of Dharma. Violations addressed through consciousness-aligned restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. All judgments emanate from Supreme Consciousness as ultimate adjudicator.
